lines.text: David gathers thirty thousand chosen men to bring the ark from Abinadab's house on a new cart.
At the threshing floor of Nacon, Uzzah takes hold of the ark, and God strikes him down for his irreverence.
David fears the LORD, takes the ark to Obed-edom's house for six months, and the LORD blesses that household.
The ark is carried up on a cart, and Michal, Saul's daughter, despises David as he dances before the LORD.

wrong_details.true: carried by people, not on a cart, with David sacrificing an ox and a fattened calf after six paces

lines.text: David blesses the people and gives them bread and cakes, then tells Michal he will humble himself even more.
